normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only carries the new owner value into the ownership transfer function.
The parameter feeds the pendingOwner state that claimOwnership later promotes.
The key identifies the target set and has no independent semantics.
The address is only inserted into the set managed by this function.
The manager address is directly forwarded to the set insertion logic.
The wallet address is only used to write the ENS ownership records.
The quota value is immediately downcast and stored by changeQuota.
The amount is added to the rolling spent quota of the wallet.
The lock value is validated against block.timestamp and stored.
The owner is validated by signature and passed to initOwner.
The module list is iterated and bound to the new wallet.
The signature is consumed by validateRequest_ to authorise creation.
The meta transaction struct drives the external call and the fee payment.
The signature is only used by the post-call validation step.
The module address is checked against the registry and stored.
The destination address is the call target of the Ether transfer.
The amount is the value attached to the low-level call.
The gas limit is forwarded directly into the low-level call.
The hash is the message digest passed to ecrecover.
The signature bytes are decoded into r, s and v and validated.
The value is the operand of the bounded downcast.
The implementation address is written into the fixed proxy slot.
The data is verified against the wallet owner signature.
The signature is passed to the signature verification library.
The local storage pointer aliases the sets mapping inside this function.
The local position drives the swap-and-pop bookkeeping of the function.
The local reference aliases quotas[wallet] to mutate spend fields.
The local intermediate value feeds the quota decay calculation of the function.
The gas snapshot is only meaningful inside the meta transaction execution.
The measured gas usage determines the relayer reimbursement of the function.
The resolved module address is the target of the fallback's external call.
The recipient alias is the payable target of the Ether transfer call.
